status: partial historical model profile; architecture reference only

guidance_computer.note: Apollo 11 1201/1202 meanings, restart protection, source-backed alarm chronology, and controller-product field semantics are sufficient for the fixed reference-event architecture. The domain remains partial because exact real-time Executive workload generation and a complete counterfactual alarm-response model are not historically validated; those are not required by the current adapter.

backup_guidance.note: Apollo 11 AGS/PGNS monitoring source pairs and several component limits are source-bounded. A causal AGS numerical model is not executed by the current reference-event adapter and is deferred until a selected branch requires backup-guidance dynamics/control. Automated historical cross-source comparison remains a separate guidance-monitoring question.

landing_radar.note: Apollo-11-effective DATA GOOD chronology/requalification, range-scale behavior, beam/reference transform boundary, velocity reasonableness/weighting update, and controller field semantics are source-bounded and implemented for deterministic/reference-event use. The domain remains partial because historical stochastic LM-5 measurement/error generation and exact Mission-G ground routing/cadence are blocked on named source recovery; those capabilities are not required by the current explicit reference-event adapter.

propulsion.note: Generic variable-thrust machinery and multiple Apollo 11 mission checkpoints exist, but exact LM-5 flight-effective thrust/calibration and delivered performance remain unresolved/blocked on named archival sources. The current reference-event adapter does not execute a propulsion model; generated historical descent dynamics therefore remain a separate blocked capability.

translational_dynamics.note: Generic translational propagation exists, but an exact continuous Apollo 11 as-flown descent history is not directly available as primary-source truth and would require explicitly reconstructed/estimated inputs. The current reference-event adapter does not execute continuous trajectory propagation, so this model is deferred for that scope and remains unresolved for generated historical dynamics.

controller_observation.note: Apollo 11 MSK-1137 field semantics, landing-radar/PGNS product family, CONTROL antenna-position state, landing poll topology, FLIGHT integration, and CAPCOM relay are sufficient for the current neutral controller-product boundary. Exact Mission-G per-field source identifiers, engineering conversion, CCATS/RTCC ownership, request cadence, and display timing remain blocked on PHO-TR155/Data Formats/data-pack recovery.

guidance_monitoring.note: Apollo 11 PGNCS/AGS/MSFN source topology, several pairwise limits, two-out-of-three monitoring structure, and human decision authority are source-bounded and sufficient for explicit controller products/readiness in the reference-event architecture. Historical automated comparison remains partial/blocked because permissible inter-source observation freshness/synchronization is unresolved; PFP 0.2/0.4-s processing cadence is not a substitute.
